subject: Feat: New Cook & Course Editor (#290)
message:
Feat: New Cook & Course Editor (#290)

New Features

Added retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) knowledge base management with Milvus integration and Alibaba Cloud OSS file handling.
Introduced comprehensive scenario management APIs and UI components for scenarios, chapters, units, blocks, and outlines.
Implemented profile management with detailed profile item definitions, values, internationalization, and UI selectors.
Added user authentication enhancements including optional token validation, email verification flows, and password management.
Delivered LLM prompt debugging, system prompt retrieval, and model listing APIs.
Launched a new Next.js web frontend with responsive sidebar, scenario editing, authentication, and profile management interfaces.
Added tag management APIs for organizing tags and tag types.
Introduced Dockerfiles, docker-compose configurations, and environment variable updates for improved development and deployment workflows.
Enhancements

Improved API documentation with enhanced Swagger schemas and inline comments.
Enhanced error messages and status codes with new i18n entries.
Added course context support to profile, study, and user verification flows.
Refined user info responses to include avatar and password status.
Improved logging and error handling for external integrations and internal services.
Standardized prompt formatting and plugin loading for extensibility.
Updated prompt extraction to support inline comments and string literals.
Enhanced UI components for profile selection, outline tree management, and block content editing.
Bug Fixes

Fixed database queries to filter by active status and order by latest records consistently.
Resolved duplicate environment variable declarations and naming inconsistencies in CI and Docker workflows.
Corrected user password handling and token generation in authentication flows.
Removed debug print statements and improved logging in multiple modules.
Chores

Added ESLint, Prettier, and Tailwind CSS configurations for frontend code quality.
Updated dependencies with Milvus, gRPC, protobuf, and testing libraries.
Improved .gitignore and .dockerignore files for cleaner build contexts.
Added migration scripts for new profile and RAG models.
Refactored internal logging and removed console outputs for cleaner logs.
Documentation

Added detailed README files for new components and frontend project.
Updated installation manuals with new environment variables and configuration instructions.
Tests

Added tests for chapter outlines, profile item management, and API endpoints.
Introduced pytest fixtures for Flask app testing environment.

* fix: add logging for environment variable type conversion failures

Previously, when an optional environment variable was set to an invalid value
that failed type conversion (e.g., REDIS_PORT='abc'), the system would silently
fall back to the default value without any indication of the misconfiguration.

This change adds proper logging to warn users when type conversion fails,
making it easier to catch configuration errors early. The system still falls
back to the default value to maintain backward compatibility, but now logs
a warning message with:
- The variable name and problematic value
- The expected type
- The default value being used
- The specific error message

Example warning:

4. Add debug step to verify tag availability and version calculation
5. Prevent non-semantic tags like 'last-old-cook' from interfering with version calculation

**Stage 2: Publish Release**   
- ✅  Maual change the release to published.

**Stage 3: Build and Deploy** (`.github/workflows/build-on-release.yml`)
- ✅ Automatically triggered when release is published
- ✅ Builds multi-platform Docker images (linux/amd64, linux/arm64)
- ✅ Pushes to multiple registries (Docker Hub, Aliyun)
- ✅ Updates Docker Hub repository descriptions
- ✅ Provides comprehensive deployment instructions

subject: feat: implement resizable outline tree panel in Shifu editor (#964)
message:
feat: implement resizable outline tree panel in Shifu editor (#964)

* feat: implement resizable outline tree panel

Add draggable resize functionality to the outline tree in the editor:
- Install and integrate react-resizable-panels library
- Create useEditorLayoutState hook for layout state management
- Support width persistence via localStorage
- Support double-click to restore default width (20%)
- Support collapse/expand with width restoration
- Fix CSS transition causing drag delay by using specific transition properties

Key changes:
- Replace flexbox layout with PanelGroup/Panel components
- Use PanelGroup.onLayout callback to track layout changes
- Use PanelGroupHandle.setLayout() for programmatic layout updates
- Change transition-all to transition-[max-width,opacity] to avoid interfering with drag responsiveness

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat: increase resize handle hit area for better UX

Expand the resize handle from 2px to 10px wide to improve drag usability:
- Keep visual indicator as thin 2px line
- Expand clickable/draggable area to 10px for easier cursor targeting
- Use Tailwind group utility to maintain hover effects
- Wrap visual line in container for proper hit area

This makes it much easier for users to grab and drag the resize handle
without precise cursor positioning.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: prevent infinite render loop in useEditorLayoutState

Fix maximum update depth exceeded error caused by dependency array:
- Change getOutlineWidth dependency from [layout] to [layout.savedOutlineWidth, layout.outlineWidth]
- This prevents the callback from being recreated on every layout change
- Only recreate when the actual values used inside the callback change

The issue was that getLayoutArray depended on getOutlineWidth, which
depended on the entire layout object, causing unnecessary re-renders
and eventually triggering React's infinite loop protection.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: remove double background on resize handle

Fix visual issue where resize handle showed two shades of gray:
- Add bg-transparent to PanelResizeHandle to ensure outer container has no background
- Remove absolute positioning from inner visual indicator (not needed with flex centering)
- This ensures only the 2px line is visible, not the 10px container

The issue was caused by PanelResizeHandle potentially having a default
background or the container background bleeding through.

subject: fix: bind google oauth to existing temp user (#993)
message:
fix: bind google oauth to existing temp user (#993)

———

  Summary

  - Ensure Google OAuth login reuses the existing temporary user created via /user/require_tmp instead of creating a separate account.
  - When a user completes Google login, the backend now upgrades the temp user to a registered user and binds Google/email credentials on that same user.

  Changes

  - src/api/flaskr/route/user.py:google_oauth_callback
      - Add @optional_token_validation so the current temp token (from /user/require_tmp) is resolved into request.user.
      - Pass current_user_id into OAuthCallbackRequest so providers can see which temp user initiated the flow.
  - src/api/flaskr/service/user/auth/base.py:OAuthCallbackRequest
      - Add current_user_id: Optional[str] field to carry the user ID resolved from the temp token.
  - src/api/flaskr/service/user/auth/providers/google.py:GoogleAuthProvider.handle_oauth_callback
      - Load origin_aggregate from request.current_user_id when present.
      - When no existing Google/email account is found, fall back to origin_aggregate so the temp user is reused instead of creating a new user.
      - When updating an existing aggregate, also upsert_credential for the email provider to ensure the email credential is stored and verified according to Google’s email_verified flag.
      - When creating a new user via ensure_user_for_identifier, prefer origin_user_id as user_bid so the temp user is upgraded in-place.

  Behavior before

  - Frontend called /user/require_tmp to create a temp user and stored its token.
  - Google OAuth was completed without using that temp user ID explicitly; the backend could create or reuse a user independent of the temp user, leading to:
      - Multiple user records for the same person in some flows.
      - Temp user’s study data not obviously connected to the final Google account.

  Behavior after

  - The Google callback receives the same token (via Token header) that came from /user/require_tmp.
  - The backend resolves that token to current_user_id and passes it into the Google auth provider.
  - The provider now:
      - Reuses the existing Google/email user if present (unchanged behavior).
      - Otherwise, reuses the temp user (current_user_id) as the base user and upgrades it to USER_STATE_REGISTERED, binding email + Google credentials.
  - This means “temp user → Google login” becomes a clean upgrade path instead of creating a separate user.

  Testing

  - Manual:
      - Start backend with valid Google OAuth config.
      - Open Cook Web as a fresh user (no token) to generate a temp user via /user/require_tmp.
      - Complete Google OAuth login from the UI.
      - Verify:
          - The Google callback is called with Token header.
          - The same user record (based on current_user_id) is upgraded to registered and has Google/email credentials.
  - Automated:
      - pre-commit run (passes).
      - (Optional) Run pytest for user/auth modules if CI is configured for them.

  Notes / Migration

  - This change does not introduce DB schema changes.
  - Existing Google/email users continue to work as before; only the “no existing account + having a temp user token” path now reuses the temp user instead of creating a new record.

  ———

* feat: render interactive modules using translated content in the database

When generating interactive type content, priority is given to the translated content in the database. If no translation content is available,

Return to the original content. This change improves the accuracy of multi-language support and ensures that users see the latest translations.

In addition, content rendering logic has been adjusted in the preview service to ensure that translation results from LLM are used correctly.

* feat: optimize interactive content rendering logic to support translation

When generating interactive type content, add complete rendering processing of the content (including translation) to ensure that the content is displayed in different process nodes

The returned content is processed uniformly. Changes include:

- Add content rendering logic in scenarios such as no cache block, after risk check, and after verification errors

- Replace the original content field with the rendered content

- Unified variable naming and change translated_content to rendered_content to more accurately express the semantics

* feat: Optimize interactive block content generation logic and update dependent versions

Refactor the processing logic of interaction type blocks in the get_learn_record function to ensure that user input records are correctly identified and merged.

At the same time, adjust the index source and version of the markdown-flow package, and use the alpha version of the test source to support the latest features.

Reconstruct how to handle the ROLE_STUDENT record in the get_learn_record function,

Directly skip all student role records, and when looking for user input corresponding to the interaction block,

Traverse subsequent records to accurately match student input in the same location.

Initialize the generated_content of the interaction block to an empty string, delaying filling of user input. new

The_render_interaction_block function is used to render the interactive block content with translation and update the learning record

Logic is generated to correctly handle the association of content displays of interactive blocks with user input.

At the same time, modify the get_markflow_output_language function logic,

Get the corresponding localized language name through the current language, and the default fallback is "English".

Remove outputLanguage fields that are no longer used in each language pack.

subject: refactor: use context v2 for preview (#1165)
message:
refactor: use context v2 for preview (#1165)

## Summary
- Replace legacy preview flow with context v2 preview handler and shared mdflow utilities.
- Preview uses Redis-backed context (no DB writes) while C-side learning remains DB-backed.
- Centralize mdflow processing (init/process/context/user_input handling) for reuse.

## Detailed Behavior
- **Shared mdflow layer**: `MdflowContextV2` wraps `MarkdownFlow` init + `process`/`get_block(s)` and provides helpers for:
  - normalizing preview `context` payloads
  - normalizing user input into `{var: [values]}` map
  - flattening user input to text for context storage
  - building chat context from `LearnGeneratedBlock` history
- **C-side learning** (`RunScriptContextV2`):
  - builds context from `LearnGeneratedBlock` records (DB)
  - runs mdflow via `MdflowContextV2` for interaction/content blocks
  - persists `LearnGeneratedBlock` + `LearnProgressRecord`
- **Preview** (`RunScriptPreviewContextV2`):
  - resolves prompt: request > outline chain > shifu
  - resolves LLM settings: request > outline > shifu > default
  - context source: request `context` (normalized) or Redis cache
  - cache invalidation: `block_index=0` or mdflow content hash change
  - emits SSE `content`/`interaction`/`text_end` only; no DB writes
  - appends user input + generated content to Redis for next block

subject: fix: ensure struct root node id is updated when importing shifu (#1311)
message:
fix: ensure struct root node id is updated when importing shifu (#1311)

When updating a demo shifu via import_shifu, the struct's root node id
was not being correctly updated because save_outline_tree_history relied
on get_shifu_history to retrieve the correct shifu id. This caused C-end
preview mode to fail to load the shifu's system prompt since it queries
by the struct's shifu id.

Added an optional shifu_id parameter to save_outline_tree_history that
explicitly sets the root node id, ensuring the correct shifu database id
is persisted in the struct.

* fix(tts): prevent offset drift when markdown completes across chunks

Track raw buffer offset instead of preprocessed-text offset.
preprocess_for_tts() is not idempotent across a growing buffer:
when markdown constructs (bold, links, code blocks) span across
chunks, their completion changes the preprocessed output length
for already-processed text, causing _processed_text_offset to
misalign and silently skip middle text segments.

Fix: preprocess only the unprocessed raw buffer portion each time,
and use binary search to map preprocessed positions back to raw
buffer positions for offset advancement.

Adds regression tests for bold and link constructs spanning chunks.

subject: fix: profile variable scope mismatch between settings page and run interface (#1385)
message:
fix: profile variable scope mismatch between settings page and run interface (#1385)

* fix: run context uses same profile storage rules

* fix: profile variable scope mismatch between settings page and run interface

Two bugs caused system variables (nickname, background, etc.) seen during
lesson runs to differ from what the user set on the personal settings page:

1. _get_latest_variable_value() prioritised variable_bid matching over
   recency.  When multiple VariableValue records existed for the same key
   at global scope but with different variable_bid values (created from
   different courses' Variable definitions), the function could return a
   stale record instead of the newest one.

   Fix: match by key only; since the values list is already sorted by
   id DESC, next() naturally returns the newest record.

2. update_user_profile_with_lable() always saved VariableValue records
   with shifu_bid='' (global scope), even for custom (course-specific)
   variables.  But save_user_profiles() (called during run) saved custom
   variables with shifu_bid=course_id.  get_user_profiles() reads
   course-scoped values first, so it would find the (potentially stale)
   run-time value instead of the newer settings-page value.

   Fix: use the same scope logic as save_user_profiles() — system
   variables (in PROFILES_LABLES) go to global scope, custom variables
   go to course scope.

subject: chore(scripts): add DB migration script for OSS domain rename (#1415)
message:
chore(scripts): add DB migration script for OSS domain rename (#1415)

* chore(scripts): add DB migration script for OSS domain rename

scripts/migrate_oss_domain.py replaces old OSS base URLs stored in the
database with new configurable ones.  Affected tables/columns:

  - shifu_draft_outline_items.content    (embedded image URLs in MarkdownFlow)
  - shifu_published_outline_items.content
  - scenario_resource.url
  - resource.url
  - learn_generated_audios.oss_url       (TTS audio)
  - user_users.avatar                    (user avatars)

The old/new URL mapping is driven by environment variables
(ALIBABA_CLOUD_OSS_BASE_URL / ALIBABA_CLOUD_OSS_COURSES_URL) or
command-line flags, so no domain name is hardcoded in the script.

Usage:
  # dry run
  python scripts/migrate_oss_domain.py

  # apply
  python scripts/migrate_oss_domain.py --apply \
      --new-cn https://res.ai-shifu.cn \
      --new-com https://res.ai-shifu.com

* chore(scripts): harden migrate_oss_domain.py based on code review

Fixes from code review:

- Transaction safety: switch to engine.begin() so the entire migration
  runs in a single transaction; any failure triggers automatic rollback
  instead of leaving the database in a half-migrated state.

- Batch updates: replace single large UPDATE with a LIMIT-based loop
  (default 500 rows/batch, tunable via --batch-size) to avoid full-table
  locks on large deployments.

- Credential masking: DB URL is now masked (***:***@) before printing
  to avoid leaking passwords in terminal output or CI logs.

- Remove hardcoded DB name default: DB_NAME no longer falls back to
  'agiclass'; an explicit error is raised when the variable is unset,
  preventing silent connections to a wrong database.

- Remove unused import: drop 'from typing import Optional'.

- Structured logging: replace print() with logging so INFO/WARNING/ERROR
  are distinguishable and greppable.

- Whitelist assertion for table/column identifiers (defence-in-depth).

- Post-migration cache flush reminder added to output.

- --batch-size CLI flag for operator control.

subject: feat(cook-web): redesign billing plans as a comparison table (#1596)
message:
feat(cook-web): redesign billing plans as a comparison table (#1596)

* feat(cook-web): merge monthly and yearly billing plans into single tab

Combine the previously separate "Monthly" and "Yearly" billing tabs into
one unified "Plans" tab so creators can compare all subscription options
side by side. Drop the daily-plan tab entry entirely from the front end
(daily plans, if returned by the catalog, are no longer shown). Tighten
the plan card grid (gap-4, minmax 220px) and reduce per-card padding so
the combined list fits on a single row at typical admin widths while
gracefully wrapping on narrow viewports.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(cook-web): replace billing plan cards with comparison table

Swap the grid of subscription cards for a single comparison table that
keeps every plan visible on one screen. Columns hold each plan's title,
description, price, and subscribe button; data rows surface credits per
cycle, learner capacity, and validity inline; the entitlements section
lists only the perks each column actually unlocks (no struck-through
placeholders) so low-tier columns stay short and high-tier columns grow
naturally to convey value progression. Drop the now-unused
PlanShowcaseCard and PlanFeatureList. Collapse the three baseline COMMON
entitlements into one "All teaching and learning features" entry, and
regenerate the i18n key index.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(cook-web): refine plan column header and add validity tooltip

Restructure the comparison table column header so the price and credit
allotment read as one paired stat: price stacks above credit amount with
a shared "/ 每月" or "/ 每年" period below, separated by a thin divider.
Move the plan description (suitable scenario) out of the header into its
own dedicated row across all columns. Lock columns to equal width via
table-layout: fixed plus per-col percentage widths. Replace the long
validity copy with a short value (e.g. "30 天" / "1 年" / "15 天") plus
an info icon that reveals the full eligibility rule on hover, including
how end dates are calculated for monthly and yearly cycles.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(i18n): refine billing plan validity and credit period copy

Update Chinese microcopy on the billing comparison table and mirror the
edits in English. The baseline entitlement reads "完整授课和学习功能" /
"Full teaching and learning features"; the validity tooltip wording now
phrases each cycle as "starts from the day you receive it (inclusive)";
and the trial column's credit period label is shortened from "一次性
赠送" / "One-time grant" to "一次性" / "One-time" so it visually aligns
with the monthly and yearly period markers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(cook-web): polish billing comparison table typography and copy

Centralize the comparison table's typography in a small set of SCSS
mixins (font-headline, font-title, font-body, font-label, font-action,
font-badge) and color variables, so future visual updates can be made
in one place. Drop the "权益对比" section divider and the price/credit
inline divider for a calmer rhythm; add an inline "权益" label above
the entitlement list to mirror the other data rows. Make the scenario
description, period suffix, and learner/validity values share the same
weight and color as the rest of the body copy. Trim long labels and
descriptions in i18n (zh-CN copy authored by the user, en-US mirrored)
and rename the validity row to "积分有效期" / "Credit validity" for
clarity in the credits-focused table.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore: apply pre-commit auto-fixes for billing changes

Run pre-commit on the touched billing files. Prettier reformats a few
multi-line function signatures and imports into single lines, sorts the
top-level keys in the billing i18n JSON files, and the i18n key index is
regenerated to match the new key order. No behavior or copy changes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore: address PR review feedback on billing comparison table

- Drop leading "/" from everyDays/Months/Years labels to match perDay/Month/Year
- Lowercase fill: currentcolor per CSS value-keyword-case
- Replace deprecated word-break: break-word with overflow-wrap: anywhere

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(cook-web): polish billing comparison table layout and copy

- Hide trial column via renderFreeCard=false; keep trial data wiring
  intact for re-enabling once the 15-day grant flow ships.
- Merge billing interval suffix into the price line (e.g. "¥0.01 / 月")
  via a local shortenIntervalLabel helper; drop the standalone period div.
- Update predicted-learner copy for advanced/pro/premium tiers to align
  with the new capacity guidance (Up to ~500/1,000/1,500 learners).
- Rename common.allTeachingAndLearning copy to "全部教研教学功能" /
  "All teaching & research features".
- Drop the "一次" / "One" qualifier from the premium onboarding training
  entitlement.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(i18n): align welcome trial dialog copy with 15-day basic plan

Reframe the new-creator welcome dialog message as a 15-day Basic plan
grant instead of a generic free trial package. Backend trial product
configuration is intentionally left unchanged - this is a copy-only
adjustment to keep the marketing narrative aligned with the comparison
table positioning.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(cook-web): address PR 1596 review feedback on comparison table

- Make tooltip triggers keyboard-accessible by adding tabIndex on the
  span wrappers around the disabled action button and validity hint.
  Disabled buttons skip focus per HTML spec, leaving Radix tooltips
  unreachable for keyboard users without a focusable wrapper.
- Trim residual whitespace in shortenIntervalLabel so labels like
  "每 2 个月" do not render as " 2 个月" with a leading space.
- Suppress the validity tooltip text when billing_interval_count > 1,
  since the singular "30 days" / "one year" copy contradicts the
  multi-cycle short label. Multi-cycle plans currently render no
  tooltip until pluralized copy is provided.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

- Replace hardcoded "..." loading dots and "—" empty-cell text in
